# Handmade Lucky Cat Bracelet: Fortune Cat Charm with Ceramic Beads

Wear a little good fortune every day. This handmade bracelet pairs ceramic and crystal glass beads with a lucky cat charm, making it a meaningful accessory for everyday style.

## Thoughtful Features

Each set includes the bracelet, a red string, and a gift box. The adjustable design fits wrists from 5.7 to 6.69 inches, and the ceramic and crystal glass beads give it a polished, personal look.

## Symbolic Colors for Every Intention

Lucky cats are traditionally linked to different wishes. Choose white for purity and creativity, black for protection, red for good health, green for family, blue for wisdom and career success, pink for love, purple for prosperity, or gold for wealth.

## Benefits for Everyday Life

This bracelet serves as a daily reminder to focus on hope and confidence. It also makes a thoughtful gift for a partner, mother, friend, or teacher, and the included gift box makes presenting it simple.

## Find Your Lucky Cat Today

Add this charming bracelet to your collection and let your lucky cat travel with you. Click "Add to Cart" to start your own good-fortune ritual.
